svg.title: Imperium request pipeline
svg.desc: Diagram of how Imperium handles a command such as 'Play Drake on Spotify' sent from a phone: 01 pair (token-paired auth, deny by default), 02 plan (Claude turns text into steps), 03 permit (risky actions need a confirm tap), 04 gate (scripts are lexed and policy-checked), 05 run (AppleScript and app integrations). Every stage writes to an append-only audit log.
